description: Use this to read the complete text of one news release. Give it the release id or 6ix.com link another 6ix tool returned. Returns the release as issued, with its date, issuer and the service that distributed it. A long release comes in parts (the answer says which part of how many): ask for part 2 and on, or pass nextCursor as cursor, to read the rest.

cursor.description: To read on: nextCursor from this tool's last answer, exactly as given, with the same other arguments

part.description: Which part of a long release to read (default 1); the answer says how many there are

name: get_news_release

hasMore.description: Later parts follow: ask for part + 1, or pass nextCursor as cursor

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to read the next part; null after the last part

omitted.description: What 6ix does not serve here, and where to find it

parts.description: How many parts the whole text has

range.description: Where this part sits in the whole text (character offsets, end excluded)

text.description: This part of the release's text

textComplete.description: true when the parts together hold all the text 6ix has for this release; false when 6ix holds only a summary or no text, or a filing runs past what is served here (see omitted)

totalChars.description: Length of the whole text across all parts

truncated.description: true when the text comes in more than one part, so this answer holds only one of them

version.description: Changes when the stored text changes; parts of one version join into the whole text

title: Read a news release
